definitions.explanation: A person or business that buys and sells used goods. In Japan, dealing in second-hand goods requires a license under the 古物営業法 (Secondhand Articles Dealer Act).

examples.japanese: {古物商|こぶつしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I obtained a second-hand dealer's license.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{古物商|こぶつしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a second-hand shop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{中古品|ちゅうこひん}→中古品：08302_chuukohin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{古物商|こぶつしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even selling used goods online may require a second-hand dealer's license in some cases.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, anyone who regularly buys and sells used goods as a business must hold a {古物商|こぶつしょう}{許可証|きょかしょう} (second-hand dealer's permit), issued by the police. This applies to physical shops, online sellers, and flea market businesses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古物商|こぶつしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ (second-hand dealer's license)
- {古物商|こぶつしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧ (to run a second-hand business)
- ⟦{古物|こぶつ}→古物：24097_kobutsu⟧{営業法|えいぎょうほう} (Secondhand Articles Dealer Act)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧ is the common everyday term for a second-hand shop. {古物商|こぶつしょう} is more formal and legal in tone, referring to the licensed dealer or the business classification.
